note: The recursion agrees with [M]'s once adjStep W, adjStep V and R d are read as the interacting inclusion, the free inclusion and L_d, but [L] takes R as an arbitrary family of complex-linear maps Drop and imposes the left-inverse and equivariance properties as separate hypotheses, where [M] defines L_d as an averaged real hypercubic-equivariant left inverse.

def corrected (W : DiffPlan S) (V : DiffPlan (Bel C.book)) (R : Drop (Bel C.book)) (U : Panel S) : Panel S
  | 0 => U 0
  | d+1 =>
    (adjStep W d).comp ((corrected W V R U d).comp (R d)) + (U (d+1)).comp (LinearMap.id - (adjStep V d).comp (R d))
